name: Machine Child
source:
Encounters with the various people in town, vacations, little adventures... A variety of small events will help your daughter grow.
The "Skills" your daughter learns and the "Connections"—your intimacy level with various characters—are the keys to the game.

Make use of the town rumors to trigger all sorts of events!

What awaits at the end of it all are 22 destinies, each symbolized by the Major Arcana of the Tarot.
You can be satisfied with your favorite ending, or you can aim to collect all the Arcana.

The fate of your adorable daughter is in your hands.
Will you be able to guide your daughter to a happy future—?
translation:
与城镇中形形色色的人相遇、度假、进行小小冒险……各种小事件会帮助你的女儿成长。

女儿学会的“技能”与她和各个角色的“关系”是游戏关键。

利用城镇传闻触发各种事件！

最终等待你的，是22种命运，每一种都由塔罗牌大阿卡那象征。
你可以满足于最喜欢的结局，也可以努力收集全部阿卡那。

可爱女儿的命运掌握在你手中。
你能引导她走向幸福未来吗？
